title: LM-based Personalized Travel Planner
abstract: arXiv:2611.25531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective travel planning requires handling multiple information sources, managing constraints, and tailoring recommendations to user preferences. While LLMs have introduced dynamic, context-aware decision-making, single-agent models often struggle with complex multi-step reasoning, constraint adherence, and modular execution. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent framework where a supervising chatbot agent coordinates specialized agents for schedule validation, user query formulation, real-time data retrieval, and constraint-aware itinerary generation. By integrating LLM reasoning, external APIs, and iterative refinement mechanisms based on a deterministic, multi-dimensional scoring framework, our approach ensures adaptability, efficiency, and personalization. translated_title: 基于语言模型的个性化旅行规划器
translated_abstract: 有效的旅行规划需要处理多个信息源、管理约束条件，并根据用户偏好定制推荐。虽然大语言模型（LLM）带来了动态的、上下文感知的决策能力，但单智能体模型在复杂的多步推理、约束遵循和模块化执行方面往往存在困难。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一个层次化多智能体框架，其中一个监督型聊天机器人智能体负责协调专门的智能体，分别用于行程验证、用户查询构建、实时数据检索和基于约束的行程生成。通过集成LLM推理、外部API以及基于确定性多维评分框架的迭代优化机制，我们的方法确保了适应性、高效性和个性化。在著名的TravelPlanner基准上的评估表明，预算约束规划性能提升了10%，在更广泛的约束集规划方面也有所提升……
tldr: 提出了一种层次化多智能体旅行规划框架，由监督智能体协调多个专门智能体，并基于多维评分机制进行迭代优化，在TravelPlanner基准上将预算约束规划性能提升了10%。
en_tdlr: We propose a hierarchical multi-agent travel planning framework where a supervising agent coordinates specialized agents with iterative refinement based on a deterministic multi-dimensional scoring framework, improving budget constraint planning by 10% on the TravelPlanner benchmark.
